risk_summary: The disclosure is generally structured and includes some quantified balance-sheet changes, but relies heavily on standard safe-h harbor, accounting-policy, and management-assurance language. Key risks include deposit outflows, increased FHLB borrowings, loan and liquidity pressures, and substantial judgment in allowance, valuation, pension, and tax estimates.
